set.body:
Scope: Volume-related Domain/SpaceRef/SpatialGraph/FieldSource/compiler/runtime pieces in modules/spatial.

Deliverable: Move anatomical volume routing/execution to neuroim4s over core graph/map/operator APIs. Remove surface/hybrid/latent cases from the volume contract and prepare explicit downstream adapter seams.

Acceptance:
- Volume routing and execution use provider domains/frames/operators without surface or atlas types and without ScalaFIM response/dataset APIs.
- Wrong-domain/frame and unavailable route checks plus volume sampling/scoped-materialization fixtures pass on JVM/JS.
- Every remaining mixed-spatial symbol has a named surface/hybrid or functional/latent destination; no universal replacement geometry hierarchy is introduced.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: I1: Separate volume spatial policy from mixed surface and latent execution
